annotations.title: Read a payment response on its chain

description: check_payment_proof reads a seller PAYMENT-RESPONSE header, or a network and a transaction hash, on a chain vet402 reads again after a purchase. It returns whether the transaction is on that chain, plus from, to, asset and amount in atomic units. A chain outside that set comes back as unsupported_network. vet402 does not pay and does not sign.

network.description: Chain id, such as eip155:8453, or a name such as base. Pass it with transaction when payment_response is left out.

payment_response.description: Seller PAYMENT-RESPONSE header as base64 JSON with transaction and network.

transaction.description: Transaction hash on that chain. Pass it with network when payment_response is left out.

name: check_payment_proof
title: Read a payment response on its chain
